inclusion_criteria: Peer-reviewed papers, widely-cited preprints (arXiv), and stable technical reports relevant to LLMs, NetOps, AIOps, and network verification
Publicly available tooling, benchmark repositories, and GitHub projects with documented artifacts or reproducible code
Works that present empirical evidence, reproduible evaluation methods, formal verification approaches, or concrete mitigation architectures
Materials published or updated from 2015 onward, with emphasis on 2019–2026 for LLM-era relevance
Sources that provide artifacts (datasets, benchmarks, validators) or clear methodologies applicable to NetOps evaluation
exclusion_criteria: Pure opinion pieces, blog posts, or marketing materials without technical detail or reproducible artifacts unless they reveal practical operator experiences
Non-public, proprietary internal reports or NDAs that cannot be cited or independently verified
Works unrelated to network operations, configuration/intent translation, verification, evaluation, or automation (e.g., LLMs used only for summarization unrelated to operations)
Papers predating foundational techniques where later better sources exist unless used for historical context
date_rationale: Prioritize literature from 2019–2026 to capture contemporary LLM advances and recent NetOps/verification tool integrations; include earlier foundational work (2015–2018) for verification/formal-methods context. Emphasize the most recent preprints, conference proceedings, and tooling repos up to the present to ensure relevance to current models and agentic frameworks.
